title: Hardship Relief on Claim Run Withholdings — Network Participation Agreements
content:
Some practices hold a large open receivable compared with what they are being paid. When Cascade withholds from such a practice's claim payment runs under the **Network Participation Agreements**, hardship relief lowers the share withheld.

**Clause.** The run hardship relief to the continuing run withholding share is set by the agreement's open receivable, measured against its claim payments in remittances dated fewer than 3 whole months before today:

- a receivable of at least 0.25 times those claim payments (25 percent of them) subtracts 25 share points;
- a receivable of at least 0.1 times them (10 percent) but less than 0.25 times them subtracts 15 share points;
- a smaller receivable, or no such claim payments, subtracts nothing.

## Terms

- **Open receivable.** The agreement's overpayment notices, less every withholding, refund and reduction booked against them.
- **Claim payments in the window.** The total of the claim payment amounts on the agreement's remittances whose date is fewer than 3 whole months before today.
- **Whole months** are the difference in calendar months from the remittance date to today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the remittance date's day of the month.

## Worked judgements (hypothetical)

| Claim payments in the window | Open receivable | Proportion | Share points subtracted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 40000.00 USD | 10000.00 USD | 0.25 | 25 |
| 40000.00 USD | 9999.99 USD | Just under 0.25 | 15 |
| 40000.00 USD | 4000.00 USD | 0.1 | 15 |
| 40000.00 USD | 3999.99 USD | Just under 0.1 | None |
| None in the window | 2500.00 USD | — | None |
